overview.title: Modern web engineering for products and platforms.
overview.description: Your web application is often the first — and most frequent — touchpoint between your business and its users. Slow load times, broken mobile layouts, and inaccessible interfaces directly impact conversion, retention, and brand perception. Forgeone builds web applications with performance, accessibility, and maintainability as foundational requirements. Whether you need a customer-facing SaaS product, an e-commerce platform, or an internal operations dashboard, we deliver web experiences that work reliably at scale.

items.question: Do you build both frontend and backend?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver full-stack web applications — frontend interfaces, API layers, database design, and deployment infrastructure. For clients with existing backends, we integrate seamlessly with your current API contracts.

items.question: How do you ensure web applications are fast?
items.answer: Performance is engineered, not optimized later. We use server-side rendering, code splitting, image optimization, CDN delivery, and caching strategies from the start. Every project includes Lighthouse performance targets in the definition of done.

items.question: Can you rebuild our existing website without downtime?
items.answer: Yes. We use parallel-build strategies — new frontend consuming existing APIs initially, then migrating backend endpoints incrementally. Users see gradual improvement without service interruption.

items.question: Do you handle SEO and accessibility?
items.answer: Both are built in, not bolted on. Semantic HTML, meta tag management, structured data, and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance are standard on every project. We validate with automated tools and manual testing.

items.question: What CMS options do you support?
items.answer: We integrate with headless CMS platforms like Contentful, Sanity, and Strapi — as well as WordPress in headless mode. The choice depends on your content workflow, team skills, and scalability requirements.
